description_en: Queries the status of voice call tasks, including the task ID, current task status, and template information associated with the task
description_zh: 创建语音通话任务后，可以查看通话任务状态，包括：任务ID、任务当前状态、任务所选的模板信息等
kebab_example: aliyun dyvmsapi list-call-task --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --template-name '身份验证' --status INIT --task-name '验证码' --task-id 1890800 --biz-type VMS_TTS --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCallTask

parameters.help_en: The current page number. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of tasks displayed per page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的任务个数。默认取值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The template name.
If the template is a text-to-speech template for voice notifications, obtain the Template Name on the Text-to-Speech Template (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/notify/list/textToVoice) page in the Voice Messaging Service console.

If the template is a voice notification file template, obtain the Voice File Name on the Voice Notification File (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/notify/list/voiceFiles) page in the Voice Messaging Service console.

If the template is a voice verification code template, obtain the Template Name on the Voice Verification Code (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/code/list) page in the Voice Messaging Service console
parameters.help_zh:
模板名称。
如果是语音通知文本转语音模板，可以在语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/notify/list/textToVoice)文本转语音模板页面获取模板名称。

如果是语音通知文件模板，可以在语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/notify/list/voiceFiles)语音通知文件页面获取语音文件名。

如果是语音验证码模板，可以在语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/code/list)语音验证码页面获取模板名称
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.help_en:
Create task status. Valid values:

INIT: Create task is created but not started.
RELEASE: Create task is being parsed.
RUNNING: Create task is running.
STOP: Create task is paused.
SYSTEM_STOP: Create task is paused by the system.
CANCEL: Create task is canceled.
SYSTEM_CANCEL: Create task is canceled by the system.
DONE: Create task is completed.

You can view create task status on the Task Center page in the Voice Messaging Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/task/list)
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态。取值：

INIT：新建任务，任务未启动。
RELEASE：任务解析中。
RUNNING：任务运行中。
STOP：任务暂停。
SYSTEM_STOP：系统暂停。
CANCEL：任务取消。
SYSTEM_CANCEL：系统取消。
DONE：任务已完成。

您可以在语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/task/list)任务中心页面，查看任务状态
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The task name.

You can view the task name on the Task Center page in the Voice Messaging Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/task/list)
parameters.help_zh:
任务名称。

您可以在语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/task/list)任务中心页面，查看任务名称
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en:
The task ID.

Obtain the task ID by calling the CreateCallTask (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-createcalltask) operation.

View the task ID on the Task Center page in the Voice Messaging Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/task/list)
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID。

通过CreateCallTask接口 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-createcalltask?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.51c25dac5r5vgj)获取任务ID。

在语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/task/list)任务中心页面，查看任务ID
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The node templatetype. Valid values:

VMS_VOICE_TTS: text-to-speech template for voice notifications.
VMS_VOICE_CODE: voice notification file template.
VMS_TTS: voice authenticate code template
parameters.help_zh:
任务模板类型。取值：

VMS_VOICE_TTS：语音通知文本转语音模板。
VMS_VOICE_CODE：语音通知文件模板。
VMS_TTS：语音验证码模板
parameters.name: biz_type

Code.description_en:
The response code.
A value of 200 indicates that the request was successful.
For other error codes, see [API error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）

返回200代表请求成功。

CompleteTime.description_en: The time when the task was completed. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
CompleteTime.description_zh: 任务完成时间。Unix时间戳格式，单位：毫秒

DataType.description_en:
The called number type.

The called number type is specified when you create a call task (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-createcalltask)
DataType.description_zh:
被叫号码类型。

在创建通话任务 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-createcalltask?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.c24e3a52pFfNZV)时已选择被叫号码类型

FireTime.description_en: The scheduled start time of the task. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
